verdict.rationale: Simular's Sai is an autonomous computer-use agent that carries out plain-language tasks. It is fair to ask whether such a product surfaces AI insights or suggestions from user data, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers task execution, skills, scheduling and approvals. Nothing documents in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the user's data. Community scripts like a Calendar-to-Docs digest are user-adaptable automations, not a product insight capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
